nodes.label: Business Knowledge RAG
nodes.rationale: Users ask questions like 'Berapa revenue bulan lalu?' and the system retrieves the relevant Revenue business rule so the LLM generates SQL consistent with the business definition instead of guessing from column names.

nodes.label: Business Rules Indexer (index_business_rules)
nodes.rationale: embeds 'term: definition' for each rule so retrieval can match rules semantically.

nodes.label: Hybrid Retrieval Strategy (pqgvector + ILIKE)
nodes.rationale: embedding similarity alone can miss exact business terms; combining pgvector embedding search with ILIKE keyword match on the term field and merging (dedup by id, limit to top_k) improves term recall alongside semantic matches.

nodes.label: API Integration (/ai/retrieve, /ai/index)
nodes.rationale: reuses the existing /ai/retrieve and /ai/index endpoints by adding rules retrieval/indexing alongside the schema equivalents and returning both contexts.

nodes.label: SQL Generator Prompt Integration (generate_sql)
nodes.rationale: when a business rule exists for a term in the question, use the rule's definition instead of assuming from column names.

nodes.label: Seed Business Rules (backend/seeds/seed.sql)
nodes.rationale: retrieval needs a baseline of 10+ rules (Revenue, Active User, Monthly Revenue, Enterprise Customer, Gross Profit, Net Profit, Customer Lifetime Value, Churn Rate, Average Order Value, Customer Segmentation) so it returns useful definitions.
